workload_proxy.meaning: Tracked normalized-source size is a lower-bound capacity proxy only; it is not a prediction of compiled Malbolge size.

selection_rule: The current tracked normalized source proxy exceeds thirteen-trit capacity by 885,609 words. Fourteen trits is now the first inherent ternary width exceeding the proxy and leaves 2,303,037 words; compiled-size and runtime measurements remain authoritative for any future profile increase.

initial_selection_snapshot.meaning: Retains the tracked snapshot used when malbolge-2026.2 was selected; current capacity is revalidated separately below.
